items.distractor_fact: Komşu kasabadaki ölçüm istasyonu aynı sabah {D} derece kaydetti.
items.gloss_en: The measuring station in the neighboring town recorded {D} degrees that same morning.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different town's measuring station, not the instrument whose noon/dawn readings the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Aynı gün başka bir hisse {D} dolardan işlem gördü.
items.gloss_en: On the same day, another stock traded at {D} dollars.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different stock, not the one whose opening/closing price the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Komşu gölün su seviyesi aynı sabah {D} santimetreydi.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring lake's water level was {D} centimeters that same morning.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different lake, not the one whose morning/evening levels the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir drone aynı anda {D} metre yükseklikteydi.
items.gloss_en: Another drone was at {D} meters of altitude at the same moment.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different drone, not the one whose first/second measurements the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Aynı kargoda başka bir paket {D} kilogram geliyordu.
items.gloss_en: In the same shipment, another package weighed {D} kilograms.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different package in the shipment, not the one whose shipping/delivery weight the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Yandaki şeritteki başka bir araç o sırada {D} km/h hızla gidiyordu.
items.gloss_en: Another vehicle in the next lane was going at {D} km/h at that moment.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different vehicle, not the one whose first/second speed measurements the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir hesaba aynı gün {D} lira yatırıldı.
items.gloss_en: {D} lira was deposited into another account the same day.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different bank account, not the one whose deposit/withdrawal the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Rakip işletmenin bu ayki cirosu {D} lira oldu.
items.gloss_en: A competing business's revenue this month was {D} lira.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different, competing business, not the one whose income/expenses the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Ligdeki başka bir takım bu sezon {D} gol attı.
items.gloss_en: Another team in the league scored {D} goals this season.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different team in the league, not the one whose scored/conceded goals the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir yatırımcının bu yılki kazancı {D} lira oldu.
items.gloss_en: Another investor's gain this year was {D} lira.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different investor, not the one whose gain/loss the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir golfçü farklı bir sahada {D} vuruş yaptı.
items.gloss_en: Another golfer made {D} strokes on a different course.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different golfer on a different, unstated-par course, so it cannot pair with the story's stated par

items.distractor_fact: Farklı bir hatta çalışan otobüs aynı saatte {D} dakikada durağa ulaştı.
items.gloss_en: A bus running on a different line reached the stop in {D} minutes at the same time.
items.entity_note: belongs to a bus on a different line with its own unstated schedule, not the bus whose actual/scheduled time the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Başka bir binada bir dairenin bulunduğu kat {D}'dir.
items.gloss_en: In another building, an apartment's floor is {D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to an apartment in a different building with its own unstated reference floor, not the apartment the question compares
